text: This is the worst Mcds EVER, I ordered 2 meals and only received one only to find that they didn’t even put a patty in the burger received! A whole other meal was missing and we had no choice but to drive to them at night to rectify it. What’s the point of ordering on Uber eats when they don’t even get an order right forcing you to leave your house and drive to them! Once we arrived the service was apalling, seems like they couldn’t even comprehend what went wrong and couldn’t understand the inconvenience of it all. 5 men looked at the order on the phone and still didn’t get it right, they still forgot to add a cold drink and fries! It is honestly way beyond unacceptable, get employees who understand customer service and who can comprehend putting an order together correctly the first time. Not adding a patty and not adding a whole other meal speaks to the lack of training  and basic understanding of the employees. Seeing all the negative reviews and seeing that there is no change is disappointing . Address the issues ! There are enough reviews to prove that this isn’t a successful operation. We will never go back there again and you will continue to lose customers. Rather close down if you cannot run a franchise appropriately.
author: phoebe muthama

text:
I was the victim of a 900 rand scam in that Mc Donald. Avoid this place! I went to the McDonald's Drive-Thru on February 18th for an order of 84 rand, which I paid by credit card (and no one else ever had the card in their hands). Two days later, I had the unpleasant surprise of seeing that 25 minutes after my payment, I had been charged 900 rand at that same McDonald's.

Since then, I've filed three complaints. Someone called me the first time and told me the manager would get in touch. The complaint was then closed as "resolved," but no one ever contacted me.

I have since gone to McDonald's eight times to try to sort the situation out, but nothing has changed. I contacted McDonald’s South Africa, and they told me to go to the Sandton McDonald’s for compensation. I went there yesterday, and the manager told me she wasn’t aware of anything and that she couldn’t do anything for me.

So not only was I robbed of 900 rand at your store, but I also feel like I’m being mocked, and what’s certain is that I’m wasting my time.
author: nicolas staes

text: I have had two terrible experiences with a manger by the name of Neo at this McDonald’s. Tonight as I was ordering he kept interrupting my order, come to find out when I pay that I was over charged and did not want to refund my order. While asking him to take my details the car behind mentioned they were overcharged AS WELL!  Which could’ve been avoided had he actually listened to our orders. On top of that while waiting and going back and fourth regarding my refund I see another employee put a McDonalds cup on the drink stand and pressed the button for a little bit of sprite, drinks it and puts the cup back for the next order!!!! Previous incident I placed an order of a Oreo McFlurry with chocolate topping a few weeks ago and he handed me something that looked absolutely disgusting and when I asked what that was because it didn’t look like smooth chocolate topping he said I should take it. I ate it and of course it was disgusting, looked as if it was scrapped from the bottle of an empty tub and was stale.
author: Ashleigh Nicole Wood

text: I placed my order on Uber eats at 11:45 with an expected delivery time of 12:10. At 12:20 the delivery driver cancelled the trip as he waited so long. I called their store 6 times with no answer. I could only contact them by calling my Uber eats delivery driver and asking him to pass the phone to the manager to be told they sent my order ages ago but my driver was waiting to collect. I have waited almost an hour  and 10 minutes for an order that was meant to take 20 minutes. This is shocking service and I have still not received my food which is a joke for a brand new mc Donald’s. I want a full refund for a meal that has not been received and when it does arrive - probably in another hours time it will be cold. Absolutely shocking. I will never order from here again- a lot work needs to be done here.
author: Neath Boyd

text:
We got here at 22h00 and went in side , orderd on the self service computer and that card machine did not want to work .
We then selected pay at counter . Apon geting to the front counter where there ar 3 ladies and 4 gents the one lady said we cant pay at the counter because there is no one that can help us .......

So if i were to want to come and sit and eat in i would need to drive through and then come sit inside ?

text:
I’ve eaten here multiple times but today it ends here. We simply wanted a late night meal at 3:57am on a Sunday morning and we were met with most unfriendly manager Nelly.

She told us they cannot serve us as they need to wait for the system to restart and it’s beyond her control, we went to that McDonald’s for convenience and this is what we had to deal with. Mind you this place says they operate 24 hours but can’t serve a meal at 3:47am.

What poor excuse is that ?
Nelly is rather lucky that I won’t be posting her unfriendly face on this review.

I expect feedback from this branch as to why you falsely advertise your hours. Disappointed. This review is for improvement and we expect better!!
author: Callorin Reddy

text: I ordered a sharing meal for 3 at 16.11.24 on the 30th Nov 2025. I went home and had an item misisng (my nuggets). I called to enquire to get my nuggets to which i was told that i would get feedback on a driver to send my food. I gave the employee 20 min to which i never received a call back, so i went to the store again. I spoke to the employee and he only gave me the 6 nuggets that was missing, besides that I only received Uber driver feedback when i was already there. Like where is the customer service??? And they lost my slip for the order thats why i gave the order time to trace.

text: I live nearby this McDonalds and have used it multiple times since it opened, each time hoping for a better experience. I have to say that each time it has gotten worse. The quality of the food is very poor, I’ve had items forgotten multiple times and had to drive back to correct it and this last time, I was told that my order was wrong because I had not ordered the food correctly. This is probably one of the worst restaurants in Northern Johannesburg and I would highly recommend that people use anywhere else to purchase food.

text: After I waited close to 20 min at the drive through, I ordered chilli cheese tenders, 2 quarter pounder meals and cheese burger happy meal, tell me why they said everything was all in there and only when I get home to give my son his food, I realised I wasn’t given the happy meal! I am trying to call them and they aren’t answering!! I need my money back please and why isn’t anyone answering the phone? Also the chilli cheese tenders, how do you get these wrong, there were like 5 inside and tasted like last weeks.

text:
This has got to be the worst McDonald's ever!!! Only my second time here, and both times, orders have taken forever! First time, the staff was lovely, but they only had Large of everything. Where in Cyril's economy?!
Today, getting my order also took very long. No apology, no explanation. When I eventually asked why, I was told that there's one person in the kitchen, on a weekend. The lady taking the order was as miserable as the weather. Tjo, never again! Oh, and the pricing was wrong!

text: Would give ZERO stars if possible. I ordered on Uber eats at 10pm. They close at 00:00 on the app. My order went through and money was deducted from my account. My order has been preparing and wrapping up for over 2 hours. 3 different drivers have wasted their time being assigned to my order. I'm assuming they are closed by now, I can't even cancel my order because it says I won't get a refund since the restaurant already started preparing my order. Will never order from here again.

text: This McDonald’s has messed up my orders time and again. The service is slow and the staff has no customer service skills. On an isolated incident I had to turn back a watermelon fizz that didn’t look right and the server asked how I knew what it looked like. The second time we waited for over 30 minutes for an order without an explanation. Today my burgers look like they’ve been hit by a truck and I ordered three drinks and didn’t get a single straw.  Save your time and money.

text:
The store doesn’t operate like other McDonald’s. The display that indicates what order number needs to pick up their order, doesn’t work.

It was a kak experience. We order chips with our meals, one large and one medium. They left the chips we only realised when we arrived home. They took our receipts which I feel shouldn’t be allowed, however they took it. So we can’t go back and get our chips.

McDonald’s is known for their chips. We wanted chips so badly.

Highly irritated.

text: I think Management should pay more attention to this branch. The card machines inside don't work and customers have to go to the drive thru.
